steps.summary: One reading family on a five-size ladder, so the article is the loudest thing on the page instead of the headline.

changes.what: The article title comes down to sit modestly above the body text
Font sizes on the page collapse to a short ladder
changes.before: 21 distinct sizes (10–60px, three of them fluid)

changes.what: Two weights instead of four
One typeface for reading and interface; code uses the system monospace
changes.before: 3 families, 9 font styles downloaded (Inter, Source Serif 4, JetBrains Mono)

changes.what: Body text sized for a 70-character line
Small uppercase labels become sentence case
changes.before: 6 tracked uppercase labels (Share, On this page, Written by, table head, code language, footer columns)

changes.what: The pull quote and drop cap no longer outshout the section headings
changes.after: Pull quote 18px roman with a 2px bar; no drop cap

changes.what: Table figures line up: units move to the row label
changes.before: "18 ms", "4 h 10 m" in the cells
changes.after: "Read latency, p50 (ms)" over bare tabular figures

steps.summary: Near-monochrome: orange is kept for the keyboard focus ring and the logo, and every grey is measured for contrast.

changes.what: Orange stops decorating the article
changes.before: Accent on 11 jobs: kicker, drop cap, bullets, quote bar, callout, card meta, links, tag/TOC/button hovers, progress bar
changes.after: Accent on focus only (plus the logo's dot)

changes.what: Captions on tinted ground become readable
Subscribe button text is legible
The footer email field has an edge you can see
Green 'improvement' chips removed from the results table
changes.after: 0 — figures in the table's own ink

changes.what: Code comments readable on the dark code block
Greys share one warm hue instead of mixing warm and cool
changes.before: Two hues (85° surfaces, 264° text), OKLCH chroma up to 0.0225

steps.summary: One reading column that the headline, body and captions share, with the table and labels unboxed and the side rails kept on small screens.

changes.what: Narrower reading column
The headline block lines up with the text below it
changes.before: Centred at 860px over a left-aligned 680px body

changes.what: The results table loses its box
changes.before: Bordered, shadowed card with a tinted caption band
changes.after: No frame; first column flush with the text, 0.5px row rules

changes.what: One chip shape
changes.before: 4 shapes (kicker pill, tags, delta pills, careers badge)
changes.after: 1 shape shared by tags and the careers badge

changes.what: Radii come from a ladder
Contents and share links survive narrow screens
changes.after: Contents become a disclosure above the lead; share icons move below the article

changes.what: Site navigation stays on phones
Headings sit closer to their text than to the text above

steps.summary: Everything sits flat on the page; only the sticky header floats, and its frosted glass now stays legible over the dark cover.

changes.what: Drop shadows removed from things that don't float
changes.before: Shadow on 5 surfaces (cover, code, table, author card, card hover)

changes.what: The author bio is no longer a card
The callout becomes a ruled note
changes.after: 1px rule on its leading edge, no fill

changes.what: Header nav text stays readable while the dark cover scrolls under it
changes.before: 82% tint, blur 14px — grey nav text 3.26:1 over the cover (fails)

changes.what: The frosted header has fallbacks
changes.after: 4: opaque baseline in @supports, reduced transparency, high contrast, forced colours

steps.summary: Motion only where something changes: the looping cover animation and hover lifts go, and hovers become short colour washes.

changes.what: The cover diagram stops looping
Related-post cards wash instead of lifting
changes.law: motion dials: hover on a card
changes.after: Background wash, 200ms in · 250ms out, no travel

changes.what: The 'All posts' arrow no longer nudges on hover
Button press is a quick squeeze on pointer-down
Durations come from a named ladder

steps.summary: The newsletter field gets a visible label and its promise as a hint below it; every other label already said what it does.

changes.what: The email field is labelled on screen
changes.before: Label hidden; only an example address as placeholder

changes.what: The field's hint sits under it and is read with it
changes.before: "One email a fortnight, no tracking pixels." in the paragraph above
changes.after: Under the field, linked by aria-describedby

changes.what: An empty submit is caught
changes.after: required, so the browser asks for an address
